gate_results.name: rule_compliance
gate_results.rationale: Local archive static contract, unique root agent.py, banned import/call scan, size limits, clean extracted imports, finite actions, import/create under 10 seconds, act under 5 seconds and RSS under 1024 MB all passed. gate_results.name: mechanism_activation
gate_results.rationale: The candidate ZIP is the pinned stable-risk runtime; it changed driving and reduced lap time on all eleven jointly completed paired cells. Action-level causal attribution is limited because this diagnostic did not record a counterfactual action trace.

gate_results.name: competitive_or_product_outcome
gate_results.rationale: Candidate completed 11/12 versus control 12/12; candidate alone retired off_track on track 2 seed 336 at progress 0.5862. Completion-first selection rejects the candidate despite a 23.54 s versus 25.23 s finished-lap median and faster times on every jointly completed pair.
